deals.location: Long-stay offer · Easter · Cape Panwa, Phuket, Thailand
deals.description: 15–29 March 2027 · One-Bedroom Suite with a balcony and breakfast included. Late March is still high season in Phuket, near the end of the dry season. The weather is usually warm with plenty of sunshine, and hotel rates and crowds can ease compared with the December–February peak as the wet season approaches.
deals.priceNote: Flexible to reschedule if plans change. The rate is non-refundable and payable online. Booking.com showed €1,780 including taxes and fees on 18 November 2026, down from its displayed reference price of €3,181 (about 44% lower). Price, availability and terms may change.
deals.recommendedFor: A quiet holiday spot to unwind and escape the crowds
highlights: Access to the private beach at its sister hotel, Cape Panwa Hotel
deals.stayNote:
Kantary Bay is a quiet bayfront retreat.
Village restaurants and an evening market are a short walk away.
My highlight was taking the free shuttle to Cape Panwa Hotel, then riding the funicular tram down to its private beach.
